SELECT FN_MAKE_CODE('SUB') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_SUBSCRIBE ( SUB_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, SUBS_STATUS, SUBS_START, SUBS_END, CREATED_BY, CREATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE, PLAN_CODE, CONTRACT_CODE, BILLING_PERIOD, CURRENT_USER_COUNT, CURRENT_PRICE, NEXT_BILLING_DATE, RECENT_BILLING_DATE, BILLING_KEY ) VALUES ( #{subCode}, #{companyCode}, #{subsStatus}, #{subsStart}, #{subsEnd}, #{createdBy}, #{createDate}, #{updatedBy}, #{updateDate}, #{planCode}, #{contractCode}, #{billingPeriod}, #{currentUserCount}, #{currentPrice}, #{nextBillingDate}, #{recentBillingDate}, #{billingKey} )
mapper.select: SELECT sub_code, company_code, plan_code, contract_code, subs_status, subs_start, subs_end, billing_key, current_price, recent_billing_date, next_billing_date FROM TB_SUBSCRIBE WHERE sub_code = #{subCode}

SELECT sub_code, company_code, plan_code, contract_code, subs_status, subs_start, subs_end, billing_key, current_price, recent_billing_date, next_billing_date FROM TB_SUBSCRIBE WHERE subs_status = 'ACTIVE' AND billing_key IS NOT NULL AND next_billing_date = #{today}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SUBSCRIBE SET recent_billing_date = #{recentBillingDate}, next_billing_date = #{nextBillingDate}, update_date = NOW(), updated_by = 'SYSTEM' WHERE sub_code = #{subCode}
UPDATE TB_SUBSCRIBE SET SUBS_STATUS = #{subsStatus}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SUB_CODE = #{subCode}
UPDATE TB_SUBSCRIBE SET SUBS_STATUS = 'EXPIRED', SUBS_END = #{endDate}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATE_DATE = #{updateDate} WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND SUBS_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
